tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. White in light; a green-black in dark.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets that sit on the page.

tokens.name: wash
tokens.usage: Faint tint for small wells such as stack tiles.

tokens.name: sunk
tokens.usage: Illustration zones inside cards; white chips lift off it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text on bg and panel. Flips to light in dark mode.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text and nav links.

tokens.name: mute
tokens.usage: Captions and fine print. Passes 4.5:1 on bg in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers, tinted to the page hue.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Borders on controls and cards.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Lime. A fill only, for what you act on or what is ready. Never used as text on bg.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Soft lime wash for hover and ready states.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent. Stays dark in both themes.

tokens.name: term
tokens.usage: Terminal and code panels. Dark means something you run.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary neutral button. Inverts in dark.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text on action.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: One per page. Scales down to 3.25rem on phones.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Filenames, commands and terminal output only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside controls.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between small items; tile grids.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card inner padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between groups.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop (18px on phones).

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks in a section.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, small inline tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The hero demo card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pill tags.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The hero card only. Buttons carry no outer shadow.
